name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (battle-core table prefix data_fd2_battle_). 'summon_anim_variant_a' correctly identifies the owning state machine (variant-A 6-slot summon, dispatch entry #4); 'terminate_flag' reflects both semantics (byte latch) and that it is a flag. No Ghidra address residue (no _5401b/hex suffix); the 'a' is a domain-meaningful variant label, not address residue.
purpose: Single-byte latch that suppresses the frame-8 per-color rotation step in the variant-A 6-slot summon animation once the spell is told to wind down.
logic_summary: INIT (state_code 0) clears it to 0 before any read each run; the state-6 hold path sets it to 1; the TICK path (state 2/5/8) reads it byte-wide as a guard at frame 8 -- when nonzero, the slot's color-rotation/restart step is skipped (color index stops cycling, frame counter is not reset). Read/written only inside fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_a_6slot.
element_semantics: Boolean latch: 0 = keep rotating colors at frame-8 wrap; 1 = animation winding down, suppress color rotation. On-disk image 0x00 (zero-bss; seeded by INIT before first read).
notes: Verified via disassembly of fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_a_6slot (0x269D3): write 0 at 0x26A8B (state 0), write 1 at 0x26AB0 (state 6), MOVZX read at 0x26B87 (TICK guard before color-rotation block at 0x26B96..). read_memory(0x5401b) = 0x00 (BSS). xrefs_to = exactly 2 WRITE + 1 READ, all from the one owner function => mutable runtime scratch, not const. src comment block (anisummn.c lines ~419-429) already accurate/concise/ASCII; Ghidra data plate already present and consistent with src understanding; no edits needed. Stale unrelated compile warnings appeared in run_script_inline output (leftover scripts in ghidra_scripts dir) but the plate-read script itself completed successfully.
